_comment: One-line purpose per ml-train run number, shown on status.html. Runs dispatched after 2026-08-08 carry their doc in the run name itself (workflow `doc` input); this file backfills history and can override a bad run-name. Keep entries short — one sentence, what and why.
1: First codec on Actions: C=12 NA pilot, d_z=32 (run name 'actions').
2: Bottleneck sweep: d_z=8 — how narrow can the embedding be?
4: Bottleneck sweep: d_z=64 — the width the programme settled on.
5: Bottleneck sweep: d_z=128 — over-wide control (worse than 64).
6: wind14: +2 wind-stress channels on the NA window — first big probe jump.
8: global14: same 14 channels on the full global window (7x the pixels).
11: global14b: exact replication of global14 on another runner — measures codec seed noise (~±0.05).
12: 40k-step dispatch on hosted CPU — cancelled: 1.3 steps/s meant the job would die at timeout with no checkpoint.
13: Same as #12, cancelled with it; led to the --max-minutes wall-clock guard.
17: pixel25_40k: 2nd channel family (8 Argo levels, C=25 with SST), pixel tokens, 40k steps.
18: patch24_40k: the 3x3-patch codec, C=24, 40k — the codec behind the 0.690/0.654 head results.
19: patch24_30k: steps-matched 30k control for the patch codec.
21: pixel24_40k: pixel-token control matching patch24_40k (receptive-field ablation).
30: patch24_1M: the 1M-step headroom run (LR decay to 10% floor, probes every 50k). Verdict: FLAT from 50k to 1M — pilot size is capacity-limited.
31: 10M-codec attempt — failed in build (origin data fetch; pre-seeding-fix checkout).
32: 10M-codec attempt — failed in build (origin data fetch).
33: 10M-codec attempt — failed in build (origin data fetch).
34: 10M-codec attempt — failed in build (origin data fetch).
35: 10M-codec attempt — failed in build (origin data fetch); these five failures created the data-cache-v1 release seeding.
36: 10M 30k — silently trained on CPU at 0.5 steps/s (torch cu130 vs CUDA 12.6 driver); cancelled, led to the driver-matched install step.
37: 10M 60k — failed in build: OSNAP truth server timed out; led to truth files joining the release.
38: patch24 seed-2 — failed in build (same OSNAP timeout).
39: pixel24 seed-2 — trained and uploaded fine, then the box hit 50/50 GB disk and the probes died; checkpoint harvested, probes run in-sandbox.
40: 10M 60k (SUCCESS): ridge 0.578 — first 24-channel run above the wind-only line; MOVE 0.238; head 0.688 (single seed, unconfirmed).
41: patch24 seed-2 re-dispatch — cancelled: its checkout predated the driver fix and could have CPU-trained.
42: 10M 30k re-dispatch — cancelled to free the box for the family-3 builds.
43: patch24 seed-2 (SUCCESS): ridge 0.531, head 0.654 — the replication that retracted the pretraining margin.
44: f3_pilot_40k: FAMILY 3 opens — pilot-size codec on the 0.25-degree NA tensor (C=39, SSH included, axis from 1982).
45: f3_anchor41M first dispatch — cancelled and re-dispatched.
46: 10M 30k steps-matched control (completes the 10M pair with #40): ridge 0.556 [0.44, 0.67], MOVE 0.212 — the pair is 0.556/0.578 at 30k/60k, i.e. no step effect at 10M either.
48: f3_anchor41M: 40.7M params, ~1 epoch on the 0.25-degree tensor — the first codec trained AT its Chinchilla data anchor.
49: f3_anchor41M_seed2: accidental duplicate of #48's 40.7M config (two sessions, one fleet), kept deliberately — the two-seed house rule wanted the replicate anyway.
